lines.text: I think I'm coming down with a cold.

data.define: To begin to feel ill with something like a cold.

example.text: I think I'm coming down with a cold.

misuse.text: Don't say you 'came down with' a gift.
misuse.why: It means starting to get sick.

data.l1_ex: Kurasa aku sedang "come down with" flu.

native.tip: “come down with” = mulai sakit. Contoh: “I think I'm coming down with a cold.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “come down with”?
“come down with” = mulai sakit.
Contoh: “I think I'm coming down with a cold.” (Kurasa aku sedang "come down with" flu.)
